subject: Next steps for Medicore pilot — approvals, legal routing & timelines
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@medicore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: stakeholder owners and legal routing

Alicia / team — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum for the pilot: 

Summary of call (short):
- Goal: 6-week internal pilot (1 team) to evaluate inference latency improvements and cost profile for your anonymized record search workload.
- Primary success criteria: 95th pct latency < 250ms for typical queries, <20% token cost delta vs baseline, and no PHI exfiltration from logs.

Stakeholders we heard today:
- Economic sponsor: Kevin Long (VP Product) — cares about TCO and timeline.
- Security/Privacy: Alicia (you) + procurement/legal loop for DPA/controls.
- Procurement contact: procurement@medicore.com (you mentioned this address).

Immediate asks / proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm the single econ buyer (Kevin) and the procurement/legal owners who will handle NDA/DPA/MSA routing and expected turn times?
2) We'll send a short mutual action plan (MAP) and our standard NDA. If you prefer one of your templates, please flag.
3) For the pilot, can procurement sign a standard DPA or do you require a redline on our DPA?

Attachments: Medicore_Call_Notes_20261018.pdf (call notes / initial stakeholder map).

If you prefer a short sync with procurement + legal on Friday, we can join — propose 30 minutes.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0186

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: stakeholder owners and legal routing

Jordan — appreciate the concise recap. Confirming details from our side: 

- Econ owner: Kevin Long (he looped in on this thread).
- Procurement lead: Tara Mills (procurement@medicore.com is monitored by the team; Tara will be primary).
- Legal: I will be the day-to-day security/privacy lead; legal (external counsel) will review DPAs/MSAs for terms.

Quick notes on timeline:
- NDA: we can sign a mutual NDA quickly; Tara can approve in 1 business day if you send your standard.
- DPA + MSA: procurement + legal typically need 5-10 business days depending on redlines. If we go heavy redlines, it can be ~2 weeks.

I'll attach the SOW requirements checklist Tara mentioned so you can pre-populate the MAP.

Also: procurement wants to see a brief data handling summary (one page) specific to the pilot (where logs are stored, retention, encryption). Can you include that with the MAP?

Thanks — Alicia

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: stakeholder owners and legal routing

Jordan / Laura — good call yesterday. A couple of operational items from the AE/ops side: 

1) Econ/Deal notes: Kevin is the exec sponsor (confirmed). He'll want a one-pager on expected unit economics and estimated monthly run-rate at pilot scale (I can draft).
2) MAP: I'll build a lightweight mutual action plan covering: NDA (day 0), pilot onboarding (week 1-2), evaluation window (weeks 3-6), wrap + purchase decision (week 7).
3) Routing suggestion for legal docs: NDA -> DPA -> MSA. NDA first to unblock data access; DPA parallel with pilot prep if they prefer. For complex redlines, we recommend locking terms for pilot scope and handling enterprise-grade terms in MSA.

Laura — can you confirm turnaround expectations from Legal (we usually promise NDA within 24 hours, DPA 3-7 business days for light redlines, MSA 7-14)? Also note if you need any specific Medicore ACLs or attestations for the data summary.

I'll attach the econ one-pager and a skeleton MAP for your review.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@medicore.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: stakeholder owners and legal routing

Thanks for the context — copying what we'll need and our recommended routing/turn times so expectations are set: 

Routing & required owners (recommended):
- NDA (mutual): Alicia (day-to-day) + Procurement (Tara) — Redwood to send standard NDA V2. Target turn time: 1 business day for signature if no custom template.
- DPA (data processing): Procurement + Medicore Legal Counsel. If Medicore wants to redline, please do so in one consolidated pass. Target review window: 5 business days for light redlines; 10+ business days for material changes.
- MSA (commercial/indemnities): Typically owned by Procurement + Legal Counsel. For pilot, recommend an abbreviated MSA addendum limiting liability for pilot scope; full MSA negotiation can continue during expansion. Target: 7-14 business days depending on redlines.

Redline sequencing guidance:
1) Send Redwood_NDA_v2.pdf (attached) for quick signature.
2) Simultaneously share your DPA template (if you prefer) or review our standard DPA. We can do parallel review to avoid blocking pilot onboarding.
3) If you submit extensive redlines to DPA/MSA, please consolidate and provide a tracked list of the top 3-5 negotiation items so we can escalate internally (speeds time to resolution).

Deliverables from Redwood for Medicore procurement/legal to review:
- One-page data handling summary (Jordan will provide).
- Redwood_NDA_v2.pdf (attached).
- Redwood standard DPA (I will upload to the shared drive and link via DocuSign if you prefer).

I will plan to commit to the following internal SLOs once docs are exchanged: NDA signed within 1 business day; initial DPA redline response within 3 business days for routine requests; escalate complex commercial terms to counsel and flag to the AE.

Doc signing preference: we support DocuSign and AdobeSign. If Medicore prefers DocuSign, please confirm and we'll send the envelope.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Redwood_NDA_v2.pdf
Link: https://www.docusign.com/secure-sign/abcd-efd-2026
